address: # AAS2 script interpreter and opcode handlers (P4.6
name: docs/formats/aas2.md)
AAS_CallNative
evidence: jmp [0x24B478 + n*4]: game command n of the 1839-entry table

name: AAS_RunProgram
evidence: checks the AAS2 magic, then AAS_RunTop with AAS_CallNative

name: AAS_RunSubProgram
evidence: checks the AAS2 magic, then AAS_RunNested (used by Sub_Call)

name: AAS_Interpret
evidence: the bytecode loop: fetch opcode, read operand (length from 0x24D270), call handler 0x24D640[op]; END (0x0F) stops

name: AAS_RunTop
evidence: runs a program on an empty stack (sp = 0x200)

name: AAS_RunNested
evidence: runs a program on the current stack

name: AAS_ArgString
evidence: game-command argument n as a string (CTBL base + offset)

name: AAS_PushFloatVar
evidence: helper: push float variable n, I0 = (value != 0)

name: AAS_Op_PSHI
evidence: opcode 0x02 PSHI n: push int variable n

name: AAS_Op_PSHF
evidence: opcode 0x04 PSHF n: push float variable n

name: AAS_Op_PSHFN
evidence: opcodes PSHFN/PSHFNC: push float constant n from FTBL

name: AAS_Op_CMP_I1_IN
evidence: opcodes 0x0D/0x33/0x34: I0 = I1 - operand (switch case test)

name: AAS_Op_CAL
evidence: opcode 0x08 CAL n: n < 0x30 built-in op (add, eq, set...), else game command n-0x30

name: AAS_Op_JPZ
evidence: opcodes JPZ/JPZC/JPZS: pc = operand if I0 == 0

name: AAS_Op_JPNZ
evidence: opcodes JPNZ/JPNZC/JPNZS: pc = operand if I0 != 0

name: AAS_Op_BRZ
evidence: opcodes BRZ/BRZC: pc += operand if I0 == 0

name: AAS_Op_BRNZ
evidence: opcodes BRNZ/BRNZC: pc += operand if I0 != 0

name: Bhv_CurChar

name: Bhv_CallSub

name: Bhv_DataGet

name: Script_LifeAdd
